# Golden input data for store_scope_kind_conformance_tests: two scope kinds of the shape a PLANE
# registers at boot (`<plane>_server`, `<plane>_tool`) — the engine's vocabulary, which a dropped-in
# store's own copy of the registry never holds. The loader names no plane; the test reads the kinds
# here, as data. One `key = value` per line; `#` starts a comment.

tool = engine_tool
